title: Customer release pathways, changelog kit, and upgrade FAQ
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Goal: Produce a concise, repeatable customer-facing package for any Redwood release that touches versioning, LTS channels, or rollout gates. The package must include: a short announcement email/Intercom template, an expandable changelog with migration notes, a step-by-step migration checklist for Hosted/Dedicated/Private customers, rollback/fallback guidance, and an FAQ tailored to common upgrade concerns (SDK changes, compatibility, SLAs, private deployment constraints). This ticket bundles the templates, the authoring guidelines, and a lightweight automation spec so PMs and SREs can reliably publish release communications with minimal editing.

Context: Recent LTS and Dedicated upgrades exposed gaps where customers received generic release notes that lacked migration steps for Dedicated/private deployments (network ACLs, KMS rotation, model pinning). This causes support load spikes and escalations. We want a tested, standardized kit to reduce ambiguity and improve upgrade success rates.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement the automation pipeline (ENG ticket covers delivery), nor does it change product behavior; it's documentation + templates + comms plan only.
acceptance_criteria: One-page announcement template (email + Intercom) that can be localized and customized within 30 minutes
Changelog template with severity tags (breaking, behavioral, improvements) and migration snippet per breaking item
Migration checklist covering Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments with exact configuration snippets and rollback steps
FAQ covering top 12 customer questions (SDK compatibility, token billing, LTS timeline, rollback, security/KMS)
Comms playbook with cadence, gating checklist, and a list of stakeholders to notify (sales/CS/ops)
deliverables: Announcement templates: subject lines, short body, extended notes for docs links
Changelog kit: canonical header, per-change schema, example entries for runtime and console releases
Migration guide: Hosted quick-path, Dedicated capacity upgrade steps, Private (VPC/on-prem) special cases
Rollback & fallback runbook: how to pin older model versions, route to fallback regions, and throttle bursts
Customer FAQ + decision tree PDF for CS reps
Delivery checklist for releases (pre-send validation, localization, A/B timing)
Automation spec: minimal Intercom/SFMC payloads and GitHub Actions sample to stage the comms
comments: 2026-03-02 - Kickoff: scoped deliverables with Eng and SRE. Identified three Dedicated edge cases (KMS rotation, load balancer draining, reserved GPU capacity). Assigned draft ownership: Sofia -> announcement & changelog; Priya -> migration guide; Eng -> automation spec.

2026-03-04 - Design review: Anya provided two compact email templates (short and narrative). Decided to prefer short subject lines for Intercom and a single long-form doc for the migration guide with anchor links.

2026-03-06 - Engineering feedback: Arjun flagged that rollback instructions must include model variant mapping for quantized workloads; added example commands for pinning model versions in Dedicated clusters.

2026-03-08 - Legal/Security: preliminary review waived for customer-facing text; flagged requirement to remove environment-specific IPs and to call out KMS rotation requires a separate maintenance window in Private deployments.

2026-03-09 - Pilot: Sent a draft announcement to 5 internal beta customers and received feedback requesting clearer billing implications and a link to exact SDK version pins. Updated changelog schema to include 'recommended action' and 'impact on billing' fields.

2026-03-10 - Ready for review: consolidated artifacts in Confluence. Next: signoff from Support and Product Marketing before publishing. Assigned follow-ups to CS for FAQ validation and to Engineering for final automation samples.
